meta.title: Toward The Holy Land
meta.description: Lost in visions of the past, trapped in a fantasy paradise.

units.rawText: We continue forward carefully, mindful of that person who looks like Eosphorus. We do not encounter any other Sanctifiers along the way.
units.displayText: We continue forward carefully, mindful of that person who looks like Eosphorus. We do not encounter any other Sanctifiers along the way.

spans.text: We continue forward carefully, mindful of that person who looks like Eosphorus. We do not encounter any other Sanctifiers along the way.

units.rawText: Along the way to the peak of the Reverse Tower, doors on either side of our path open, revealing scenes from the past playing out like a movie.
units.displayText: Along the way to the peak of the Reverse Tower, doors on either side of our path open, revealing scenes from the past playing out like a movie.

spans.text: Along the way to the peak of the Reverse Tower, doors on either side of our path open, revealing scenes from the past playing out like a movie.

units.rawText: Atlas, do you think this dagger can be repaired...
units.displayText: Atlas, do you think this dagger can be repaired...

spans.text: Atlas, do you think this dagger can be repaired...

units.rawText: ...Looks like it'll be tougher than I expected.
units.displayText: ...Looks like it'll be tougher than I expected.

spans.text: ...Looks like it'll be tougher than I expected.

units.rawText: That said, I have one thing I'd like to ask... Alcyone, just what did you do that caused Electra's weapon to end up like this?
units.displayText: That said, I have one thing I'd like to ask... Alcyone, just what did you do that caused Electra's weapon to end up like this?

spans.text: That said, I have one thing I'd like to ask... Alcyone, just what did you do that caused Electra's weapon to end up like this?

units.rawText: It would have been hard to draw the connection between this lump of scrap metal and a dagger if not for Alcyone's explanation, like Atlas said.
units.displayText: It would have been hard to draw the connection between this lump of scrap metal and a dagger if not for Alcyone's explanation, like Atlas said.

spans.text: It would have been hard to draw the connection between this lump of scrap metal and a dagger if not for Alcyone's explanation, like Atlas said.

units.rawText: Apart from the bolster and the heel of the blade, which are still vaguely intact, the rest of it is pretty much unrecognizable.
units.displayText: Apart from the bolster and the heel of the blade, which are still vaguely intact, the rest of it is pretty much unrecognizable.

spans.text: Apart from the bolster and the heel of the blade, which are still vaguely intact, the rest of it is pretty much unrecognizable.

units.rawText: Atlas' question causes the Sanctifier's face to instantly turn red as she blushes.
units.displayText: Atlas' question causes the Sanctifier's face to instantly turn red as she blushes.

spans.text: Atlas' question causes the Sanctifier's face to instantly turn red as she blushes.

units.rawText: I-I didn't do it on purpose!
units.displayText: I-I didn't do it on purpose!

spans.text: I-I didn't do it on purpose!

units.rawText: You know how Electra sneaked out to other sectors on missions without telling me, right? I got mad and decided to take her dagger to play a prank.
units.displayText: You know how Electra sneaked out to other sectors on missions without telling me, right? I got mad and decided to take her dagger to play a prank.

spans.text: You know how Electra sneaked out to other sectors on missions without telling me, right? I got mad and decided to take her dagger to play a prank.

units.rawText: A prank? What kind of prank could have done this to a dagger?
units.displayText: A prank? What kind of prank could have done this to a dagger?

spans.text: A prank? What kind of prank could have done this to a dagger?

units.rawText: ...I guess it was when I tied it to a target and then shot it a few times with my arrows?
units.displayText: ...I guess it was when I tied it to a target and then shot it a few times with my arrows?

spans.text: ...I guess it was when I tied it to a target and then shot it a few times with my arrows?

units.rawText: I was thinking that if Electra's weapons got damaged, I could go out on dispatch with her using the excuse that I was compensating for reduced fighting power...
units.displayText: I was thinking that if Electra's weapons got damaged, I could go out on dispatch with her using the excuse that I was compensating for reduced fighting power...

spans.text: I was thinking that if Electra's weapons got damaged, I could go out on dispatch with her using the excuse that I was compensating for reduced fighting power...

units.rawText: But I didn't expect this to happen to her dagger! I mean, you've seen how she uses it to defend herself when practicing with me, right? How could it fall apart like this after just a couple of arrows...
units.displayText: But I didn't expect this to happen to her dagger! I mean, you've seen how she uses it to defend herself when practicing with me, right? How could it fall apart like this after just a couple of arrows...

spans.text: But I didn't expect this to happen to her dagger! I mean, you've seen how she uses it to defend herself when practicing with me, right? How could it fall apart like this after just a couple of arrows...

units.rawText: Electra didn't bring me out with her on missions because she thought I wasn't reliable enough. Now, she's going to be even less willing to fight alongside me now...
units.displayText: Electra didn't bring me out with her on missions because she thought I wasn't reliable enough. Now, she's going to be even less willing to fight alongside me now...

spans.text: Electra didn't bring me out with her on missions because she thought I wasn't reliable enough. Now, she's going to be even less willing to fight alongside me now...

units.rawText: The petite Greater Sanctifier turns a pleading look at Atlas.
units.displayText: The petite Greater Sanctifier turns a pleading look at Atlas.

spans.text: The petite Greater Sanctifier turns a pleading look at Atlas.

units.rawText: Soooo... Is there really no way to fix it? I don't want Electra to find out...
units.displayText: Soooo... Is there really no way to fix it? I don't want Electra to find out...

spans.text: Soooo... Is there really no way to fix it? I don't want Electra to find out...

units.rawText: Urgh... Well, since it's Ally asking, I'll do my best!
units.displayText: Urgh... Well, since it's Ally asking, I'll do my best!

spans.text: Urgh... Well, since it's Ally asking, I'll do my best!

units.rawText: There are some parts I'll need you to buy from other sectors, so it might be a little...
units.displayText: There are some parts I'll need you to buy from other sectors, so it might be a little...

spans.text: There are some parts I'll need you to buy from other sectors, so it might be a little...

units.rawText: Before Atlas can finish, Alcyone has already flown out of the Reverse Tower and vanishes into the distance.
units.displayText: Before Atlas can finish, Alcyone has already flown out of the Reverse Tower and vanishes into the distance.

spans.text: Before Atlas can finish, Alcyone has already flown out of the Reverse Tower and vanishes into the distance.

units.rawText: I'll go right now! Please, I'm counting on you to help me fix it, Atlas!
units.displayText: I'll go right now! Please, I'm counting on you to help me fix it, Atlas!

spans.text: I'll go right now! Please, I'm counting on you to help me fix it, Atlas!

units.rawText: ...Looks like she's really worried about it.
units.displayText: ...Looks like she's really worried about it.

spans.text: ...Looks like she's really worried about it.

units.rawText: Meh, I guess I'll have to work hard and live up to her expectations!
units.displayText: Meh, I guess I'll have to work hard and live up to her expectations!

spans.text: Meh, I guess I'll have to work hard and live up to her expectations!

units.rawText: These are all things that happened in the past... But why...
units.displayText: These are all things that happened in the past... But why...

spans.text: These are all things that happened in the past... But why...

units.rawText: Eos briefly spaces out as she loses herself in these scenes from the past. As I see these familiar sights, I can't help but feel strangely sentimental about them too.
units.displayText: Eos briefly spaces out as she loses herself in these scenes from the past. As I see these familiar sights, I can't help but feel strangely sentimental about them too.

spans.text: Eos briefly spaces out as she loses herself in these scenes from the past. As I see these familiar sights, I can't help but feel strangely sentimental about them too.

units.rawText: I was a bit wary at first, but as we went on, I realized that they weren't hindering our path forward.
units.displayText: I was a bit wary at first, but as we went on, I realized that they weren't hindering our path forward.

spans.text: I was a bit wary at first, but as we went on, I realized that they weren't hindering our path forward.

units.rawText: ...Or rather, they're acting like we don't exist at all. They aren't reacting to us in the slightest.
units.displayText: ...Or rather, they're acting like we don't exist at all. They aren't reacting to us in the slightest.

spans.text: ...Or rather, they're acting like we don't exist at all. They aren't reacting to us in the slightest.

units.rawText: What are these? Some kind of holographic projection? Or Sanctifiers who look similar to the ones from the past?
units.displayText: What are these? Some kind of holographic projection? Or Sanctifiers who look similar to the ones from the past?

spans.text: What are these? Some kind of holographic projection? Or Sanctifiers who look similar to the ones from the past?

units.rawText: Maybe it would be best to call them "materialized memories".
units.displayText: Maybe it would be best to call them "materialized memories".

spans.text: Maybe it would be best to call them "materialized memories".

units.rawText: ...Is Eosphorus trying to show us something?
units.displayText: ...Is Eosphorus trying to show us something?

spans.text: ...Is Eosphorus trying to show us something?

units.rawText: I look at the white figure who's guiding us, still fairly close by.
units.displayText: I look at the white figure who's guiding us, still fairly close by.

spans.text: I look at the white figure who's guiding us, still fairly close by.

units.rawText: Before I can ask any more questions, a new scene begins to play out.
units.displayText: Before I can ask any more questions, a new scene begins to play out.

spans.text: Before I can ask any more questions, a new scene begins to play out.

units.rawText: ...Ally's been avoiding me recently. (Sigh) Big Sis is so sad and lonely...
units.displayText: ...Ally's been avoiding me recently. (Sigh) Big Sis is so sad and lonely...

spans.text: ...Ally's been avoiding me recently. (Sigh) Big Sis is so sad and lonely...

units.rawText: Atlas, you know something about this, don't you?
units.displayText: Atlas, you know something about this, don't you?

spans.text: Atlas, you know something about this, don't you?

units.rawText: (Clears throat) Uh, you must be imagining things, Electra. Alcyone seems perfectly fine to me.
units.displayText: (Clears throat) Uh, you must be imagining things, Electra. Alcyone seems perfectly fine to me.

spans.text: (Clears throat) Uh, you must be imagining things, Electra. Alcyone seems perfectly fine to me.

units.rawText: But Ally hasn't been training with me recently... Though I don't mind too much, at least I don't need to make up excuses for goofing off...
units.displayText: But Ally hasn't been training with me recently... Though I don't mind too much, at least I don't need to make up excuses for goofing off...

spans.text: But Ally hasn't been training with me recently... Though I don't mind too much, at least I don't need to make up excuses for goofing off...

units.rawText: Oh well, free time is free time! As it happens, I just received a patrol order from Lord Eosphorus; I might as well use it to go out on a stroll~
units.displayText: Oh well, free time is free time! As it happens, I just received a patrol order from Lord Eosphorus; I might as well use it to go out on a stroll~

spans.text: Oh well, free time is free time! As it happens, I just received a patrol order from Lord Eosphorus; I might as well use it to go out on a stroll~

units.rawText: Seeya, Atlas.
units.displayText: Seeya, Atlas.

spans.text: Seeya, Atlas.

units.rawText: Um, yeah, seeya.
units.displayText: Um, yeah, seeya.

spans.text: Um, yeah, seeya.

units.rawText: After seeing Electra fly off, it takes a while before Atlas' pounding heart finally calms down.
units.displayText: After seeing Electra fly off, it takes a while before Atlas' pounding heart finally calms down.

spans.text: After seeing Electra fly off, it takes a while before Atlas' pounding heart finally calms down.

units.rawText: If Electra had stuck around any longer, his ineptitude at lying would have made it very hard for him to keep anything from the perceptive Electra.
units.displayText: If Electra had stuck around any longer, his ineptitude at lying would have made it very hard for him to keep anything from the perceptive Electra.

spans.text: If Electra had stuck around any longer, his ineptitude at lying would have made it very hard for him to keep anything from the perceptive Electra.

units.rawText: Just then, a petite Sanctifier pokes her head out of the shadows.
units.displayText: Just then, a petite Sanctifier pokes her head out of the shadows.

spans.text: Just then, a petite Sanctifier pokes her head out of the shadows.

units.rawText: Atlas! Is Electra gone yet?
units.displayText: Atlas! Is Electra gone yet?

spans.text: Atlas! Is Electra gone yet?

units.rawText: Yeah, she just left.
units.displayText: Yeah, she just left.

spans.text: Yeah, she just left.

units.rawText: Thank goodness! Fortunately, I managed to get Lord Eosphorus to do me a favor and come up with an excuse to draw her away. Otherwise, if she was still in the Reverse Tower, she'd have noticed us forging a new blade.
units.displayText: Thank goodness! Fortunately, I managed to get Lord Eosphorus to do me a favor and come up with an excuse to draw her away. Otherwise, if she was still in the Reverse Tower, she'd have noticed us forging a new blade.

spans.text: Thank goodness! Fortunately, I managed to get Lord Eosphorus to do me a favor and come up with an excuse to draw her away. Otherwise, if she was still in the Reverse Tower, she'd have noticed us forging a new blade.

units.rawText: You told Lord Eosphorus? No wonder the patrol request came in with such good timing.
units.displayText: You told Lord Eosphorus? No wonder the patrol request came in with such good timing.

spans.text: You told Lord Eosphorus? No wonder the patrol request came in with such good timing.

units.rawText: Lord Eosphorus started asking after he realized what was going on... In any case, this isn't the time to be talking about this. How's the forging going?
units.displayText: Lord Eosphorus started asking after he realized what was going on... In any case, this isn't the time to be talking about this. How's the forging going?

spans.text: Lord Eosphorus started asking after he realized what was going on... In any case, this isn't the time to be talking about this. How's the forging going?

units.rawText: Almost done. A little more time and it'll be as good as new.
units.displayText: Almost done. A little more time and it'll be as good as new.

spans.text: Almost done. A little more time and it'll be as good as new.

units.rawText: Whew...
units.displayText: Whew...

spans.text: Whew...

units.rawText: Upon hearing this, the small Sanctifier finally relaxes for the first time in several days.
units.displayText: Upon hearing this, the small Sanctifier finally relaxes for the first time in several days.

spans.text: Upon hearing this, the small Sanctifier finally relaxes for the first time in several days.

units.rawText: Hopefully, that means I'll be able to put it back in its place without letting Electra know.
units.displayText: Hopefully, that means I'll be able to put it back in its place without letting Electra know.

spans.text: Hopefully, that means I'll be able to put it back in its place without letting Electra know.

units.rawText: Oh? Without letting who know, Ally?
units.displayText: Oh? Without letting who know, Ally?

spans.text: Oh? Without letting
who
know, Ally?

units.rawText: Do you even have to ask? Obviously it's you, righ...
units.displayText: Do you even have to ask? Obviously it's you, righ...

spans.text: Do you even have to ask? Obviously it's
you
, righ...

units.rawText: <size=40>Aiiiiiieeeeeee!</size>
units.displayText: Aiiiiiieeeeeee!

spans.text: Aiiiiiieeeeeee!

units.rawText: A piteous shriek echoes through the empty halls of the Reverse Tower.
units.displayText: A piteous shriek echoes through the empty halls of the Reverse Tower.

spans.text: A piteous shriek echoes through the empty halls of the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: The perpetrator of this prank covers her ears while savoring her carefully-plotted handiwork.
units.displayText: The perpetrator of this prank covers her ears while savoring her carefully-plotted handiwork.

spans.text: The perpetrator of this prank covers her ears while savoring her carefully-plotted handiwork.

units.rawText: Aw, you guys don't need to be so scared right? Now I'm starting to feel a little embarrassed.
units.displayText: Aw, you guys don't need to be so scared right? Now I'm starting to feel a little embarrassed.

spans.text: Aw, you guys don't need to be so scared right? Now I'm starting to feel a little embarrassed.

units.rawText: E-Electra, why did you come back so quickly?! Didn't Lord Eosphorus send you out on patrol?
units.displayText: E-Electra, why did you come back so quickly?! Didn't Lord Eosphorus send you out on patrol?

spans.text: E-Electra, why did you come back so quickly?! Didn't Lord Eosphorus send you out on patrol?

units.rawText: Oh, I went over to the Pantheon when I pretended to leave just now. Turns out, Lord Eosphorus was even worse at lying than I expected and he came clean after just a few questions.
units.displayText: Oh, I went over to the Pantheon when I pretended to leave just now. Turns out, Lord Eosphorus was even worse at lying than I expected and he came clean after just a few questions.

spans.text: Oh, I went over to the Pantheon when I pretended to leave just now. Turns out, Lord Eosphorus was even worse at lying than I expected and he came clean after just a few questions.

units.rawText: Hup!
units.displayText: Hup!

spans.text: Hup!

units.rawText: As the two of them stare in shock, Electra grabs the unfinished dagger from Atlas' hands and carefully examines it.
units.displayText: As the two of them stare in shock, Electra grabs the unfinished dagger from Atlas' hands and carefully examines it.

spans.text: As the two of them stare in shock, Electra grabs the unfinished dagger from Atlas' hands and carefully examines it.

units.rawText: Oh, well done. You must have worked really hard to fix it up to this extent.
units.displayText: Oh, well done. You must have worked really hard to fix it up to this extent.

spans.text: Oh, well done. You must have worked really hard to fix it up to this extent.

units.rawText: I'm sorry, Electra, this was all my fault. If I hadn't gone and played my prank, your precious dagger wouldn't have gotten wrecked like this.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, Electra, this was all my fault. If I hadn't gone and played my prank, your precious dagger wouldn't have gotten wrecked like this.

spans.text: I'm sorry, Electra, this was all my fault. If I hadn't gone and played my prank, your precious dagger wouldn't have gotten wrecked like this.

units.rawText: I... I just wanted to go on missions with you... I wanted to prove that I was a reliable comrade and not a kid who needed protection!
units.displayText: I... I just wanted to go on missions with you... I wanted to prove that I was a reliable comrade and not a kid who needed protection!

spans.text: I... I just wanted to go on missions with you... I wanted to prove that I was a reliable comrade and not a kid who needed protection!

units.rawText: I see...
units.displayText: I see...

spans.text: I see...

units.rawText: Electra examines her beloved dagger, turning it here and there, while Alcyone carefully tries to see how Electra is feeling.
units.displayText: Electra examines her beloved dagger, turning it here and there, while Alcyone carefully tries to see how Electra is feeling.

spans.text: Electra examines her beloved dagger, turning it here and there, while Alcyone carefully tries to see how Electra is feeling.

units.rawText: While it was Alcyone's fault, I hope you won't scold her too badly, on account of how hard she tried to make up for it. In the first place, she just wanted you to approve of her...
units.displayText: While it was Alcyone's fault, I hope you won't scold her too badly, on account of how hard she tried to make up for it. In the first place, she just wanted you to approve of her...

spans.text: While it was Alcyone's fault, I hope you won't scold her too badly, on account of how hard she tried to make up for it. In the first place, she just wanted you to approve of her...

units.rawText: Aw, but it isn't Ally's fault, though.
units.displayText: Aw, but it isn't Ally's fault, though.

spans.text: Aw, but it isn't Ally's fault, though.

units.rawText: Huh? But I broke your dagger with my arrows...
units.displayText: Huh? But I broke your dagger with my arrows...

spans.text: Huh? But I broke your dagger with my arrows...

units.rawText: Oh, you mean this.
units.displayText: Oh, you mean this.

spans.text: Oh, you mean this.

units.rawText: Electra smiles and points to the dagger's ruined edge.
units.displayText: Electra smiles and points to the dagger's ruined edge.

spans.text: Electra smiles and points to the dagger's ruined edge.

units.rawText: Actually, it was broken long before Ally took it. Take a closer look. You can still see the marks from an Entropic attack, right?
units.displayText: Actually, it was broken long before Ally took it. Take a closer look. You can still see the marks from an Entropic attack, right?

spans.text: Actually, it was broken long before Ally took it. Take a closer look. You can still see the marks from an Entropic attack, right?

units.rawText: I broke it by accident on a mission, so I thought I'd just try to patch it up with operands afterwards and left it lying around, but then you took it away.
units.displayText: I broke it by accident on a mission, so I thought I'd just try to patch it up with operands afterwards and left it lying around, but then you took it away.

spans.text: I broke it by accident on a mission, so I thought I'd just try to patch it up with operands afterwards and left it lying around, but then you took it away.

units.rawText: So you're saying it was already broken from the start?
units.displayText: So you're saying it was already broken from the start?

spans.text: So you're saying it was already broken from the start?

units.rawText: Yup. So it's not your fault.
units.displayText: Yup. So it's not your fault.

spans.text: Yup. So it's not your fault.

units.rawText: Then... then... what about going out on missions together next time?
units.displayText: Then... then... what about going out on missions together next time?

spans.text: Then... then... what about going out on missions together next time?

units.rawText: I saw your practice grades recently. You've been working hard; of course we can go together.
units.displayText: I saw your practice grades recently. You've been working hard; of course we can go together.

spans.text: I saw your practice grades recently. You've been working hard; of course we can go together.

units.rawText: Yaaaaay!
units.displayText: Yaaaaay!

spans.text: Yaaaaay!

units.rawText: Alcyone breathes a sigh of relief, her face beaming with an innocent, childlike smile. Electra can't resist the urge to pinch her cheeks.
units.displayText: Alcyone breathes a sigh of relief, her face beaming with an innocent, childlike smile. Electra can't resist the urge to pinch her cheeks.

spans.text: Alcyone breathes a sigh of relief, her face beaming with an innocent, childlike smile. Electra can't resist the urge to pinch her cheeks.

units.rawText: Mmmmmfffffokaythat'senough... (Sigh) I've been so worried you'd find out and scold me these past few days.
units.displayText: Mmmmmfffffokaythat'senough... (Sigh) I've been so worried you'd find out and scold me these past few days.

spans.text: Mmmmmfffffokaythat'senough... (Sigh) I've been so worried you'd find out and scold me these past few days.

units.rawText: Hohoho, well, the past few days have been a treasure trove of your amusing expressions, Ally.
units.displayText: Hohoho, well, the past few days have been a treasure trove of your amusing expressions, Ally.

spans.text: Hohoho, well, the past few days have been a treasure trove of your amusing expressions, Ally.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: Atlas senses that Electra has just revealed something that should have stayed hidden.
units.displayText: Atlas senses that Electra has just revealed something that should have stayed hidden.

spans.text: Atlas senses that Electra has just revealed something that should have stayed hidden.

units.rawText: So you already knew the dagger was missing?
units.displayText: So you already knew the dagger was missing?

spans.text: So you already knew the dagger was missing?

units.rawText: Well, it was hard not to notice how Ally was sneaking around suspiciously. I was wondering whether or not to ask her about it, but in the end I decided to keep watching her~
units.displayText: Well, it was hard not to notice how Ally was sneaking around suspiciously. I was wondering whether or not to ask her about it, but in the end I decided to keep watching her~

spans.text: Well, it was hard
not
to notice how Ally was sneaking around suspiciously. I was wondering whether or not to ask her about it, but in the end I decided to keep watching her~

units.rawText: So don't do it again next time, alright, Al...cyone?
units.displayText: So don't do it again next time, alright, Al...cyone?

spans.text: So don't do it again next time, alright, Al...cyone?

units.rawText: The affectionate nickname catches in Electra's throat.
units.displayText: The affectionate nickname catches in Electra's throat.

spans.text: The affectionate nickname catches in Electra's throat.

units.rawText: Furious operands swell rapidly inside Alcyone's body. She has already called her bow to her hand.
units.displayText: Furious operands swell rapidly inside Alcyone's body. She has already called her bow to her hand.

spans.text: Furious operands swell rapidly inside Alcyone's body. She has already called her bow to her hand.

units.rawText: ...So in other words, you knew the truth all this time and you kept it from me?
units.displayText: ...So in other words, you knew the truth all this time and you kept it from me?

spans.text: ...So in other words, you knew the truth all this time and you kept it from me?

units.rawText: Crap crap crap I let it slip! Atlas! Save meeeee!
units.displayText: Crap crap crap I let it slip! Atlas! Save meeeee!

spans.text: Crap crap crap I let it slip! Atlas! Save meeeee!

units.rawText: Ahhh wait, don't use me as a shield!
units.displayText: Ahhh wait, don't use me as a shield!

spans.text: Ahhh wait, don't use me as a shield!

units.rawText: Take this! JUDGEMENT ARROW!
units.displayText: Take this! JUDGEMENT ARROW!

spans.text: Take this! JUDGEMENT ARROW!

units.rawText: Illusory arrows fly past our ears, like a gust of wind that comes and goes just like the memory of the past.
units.displayText: Illusory arrows fly past our ears, like a gust of wind that comes and goes just like the memory of the past.

spans.text: Illusory arrows fly past our ears, like a gust of wind that comes and goes just like the memory of the past.

units.rawText: Eos...
units.displayText: Eos...

spans.text: Eos...

units.rawText: I know, Professor. All this is nothing but echoes of days gone by, a past that cannot be changed.
units.displayText: I know, Professor. All this is nothing but echoes of days gone by, a past that cannot be changed.

spans.text: I know, Professor. All this is nothing but echoes of days gone by, a past that cannot be changed.

units.rawText: When the story ends, the smile on Eos' face seems pale and faded.
units.displayText: When the story ends, the smile on Eos' face seems pale and faded.

spans.text: When the story ends, the smile on Eos' face seems pale and faded.

units.rawText: She seems to have noticed something and turns to gently touch the cracks generated on the wall beside her. Surely, she must be recalling pleasant memories of the past.
units.displayText: She seems to have noticed something and turns to gently touch the cracks generated on the wall beside her. Surely, she must be recalling pleasant memories of the past.

spans.text: She seems to have noticed something and turns to gently touch the cracks generated on the wall beside her. Surely, she must be recalling pleasant memories of the past.

units.rawText: ...I didn't think he'd even recreate the traces of Electra and Alcyone's arguments. How...
units.displayText: ...I didn't think he'd even recreate the traces of Electra and Alcyone's arguments. How...

spans.text: Liberate? Does that mean...

units.rawText: We will restore life to the silent lands and bring the dead back to life. As you have seen, we will wipe away all pain and return everything to how it was.
units.displayText: We will restore life to the silent lands and bring the dead back to life. As you have seen, we will wipe away all pain and return everything to how it was.

spans.text: We will restore life to the silent lands and bring the dead back to life. As you have seen, we will wipe away all pain and return everything to how it was.

units.rawText: Eosphorus extends a hand to me and invites me to approach him.
units.displayText: Eosphorus extends a hand to me and invites me to approach him.

spans.text: Eosphorus extends a hand to me and invites me to approach him.

units.rawText: I attempt to step forward to try and get more out of him, but the pink-haired Doll at my side reaches out to halt me.
units.displayText: I attempt to step forward to try and get more out of him, but the pink-haired Doll at my side reaches out to halt me.

spans.text: I attempt to step forward to try and get more out of him, but the pink-haired Doll at my side reaches out to halt me.

units.rawText: Persicaria?
units.displayText: Persicaria?

spans.text: Persicaria?

units.rawText: Professor, look out!
units.displayText: Professor, look out!

spans.text: Professor, look out!

units.rawText: Before I can signal her to stop, Persicaria's sword has already cleared its scabbard in an arc of cold light, attempting to buy me and Eos time to flee.
units.displayText: Before I can signal her to stop, Persicaria's sword has already cleared its scabbard in an arc of cold light, attempting to buy me and Eos time to flee.

spans.text: Before I can signal her to stop, Persicaria's sword has already cleared its scabbard in an arc of cold light, attempting to buy me and Eos time to flee.

units.rawText: <size=40>Crash—</size>
units.displayText: Crash—

spans.text: Crash—

units.rawText: An operand shield halts the sword's strike. The operands from both sides grind against each other, spraying sparks in all directions.
units.displayText: An operand shield halts the sword's strike. The operands from both sides grind against each other, spraying sparks in all directions.

spans.text: An operand shield halts the sword's strike. The operands from both sides grind against each other, spraying sparks in all directions.

units.rawText: ...How rude. Stand down.
units.displayText: ...How rude. Stand down.

spans.text: ...How rude. Stand down.

units.rawText: Hng!
units.displayText: Hng!

spans.text: Hng!

units.rawText: He fires a razor-edged beam of starlight from his fingertip. While Persicaria cuts it down, the blast from its impact forces her several steps back.
units.displayText: He fires a razor-edged beam of starlight from his fingertip. While Persicaria cuts it down, the blast from its impact forces her several steps back.

spans.text: He fires a razor-edged beam of starlight from his fingertip. While Persicaria cuts it down, the blast from its impact forces her several steps back.

units.rawText: Persicaria!
units.displayText: Persicaria!

spans.text: Persicaria!

units.rawText: I'm okay, Professor... But things don't look good now.
units.displayText: I'm okay, Professor... But things don't look good now.

spans.text: I'm okay, Professor... But things don't look good now.

units.rawText: ...I didn't expect you to be the real thing.
units.displayText: ...I didn't expect you to be the real thing.

spans.text: ...I didn't expect you to be the real thing.

units.rawText: An illusion? No, how would I dare take you lightly, <cmdr>? I had to come and see you in person.
units.displayText: An illusion? No, how would I dare take you lightly, {교수}? I had to come and see you in person.

spans.text: An illusion? No, how would I dare take you lightly,
? I had to come and see you in person.

units.rawText: While I have much to ask you about Malkira, the opening of the passage is almost upon us, so we shall save that for after Magrasea is reborn, when we shall discuss it in great detail.
units.displayText: While I have much to ask you about Malkira, the opening of the passage is almost upon us, so we shall save that for after Magrasea is reborn, when we shall discuss it in great detail.

spans.text: While I have much to ask you about Malkira, the opening of the passage is almost upon us, so we shall save that for after Magrasea is reborn, when we shall discuss it in great detail.

units.rawText: A fire ignites in his golden eyes as he extends his invitation to all of us at the foot of his throne.
units.displayText: A fire ignites in his golden eyes as he extends his invitation to all of us at the foot of his throne.

spans.text: A fire ignites in his golden eyes as he extends his invitation to all of us at the foot of his throne.

units.rawText: Come, reside in the past with me, <cmdr>!
units.displayText: Come, reside in the past with me, {교수}!

spans.text: Come, reside in the past with me,

units.rawText: Your signal wasn't even in the tower just now when you were trying to guide us around with that bizarre illusion. Are you done playing around with us?
